#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Watch the clipboard and save unique clipboard strings after 5 minutes."""

from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
import time

import pyperclip

INTERVAL_SECONDS = 2
SAVE_AFTER_SECONDS = 5 * 60
LOG_PATH = Path("clipboard_history.log")


def save_history(unique_strings: list[str]) -> None:
    """Append the collected unique clipboard strings to the log file."""
    timestamp = datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")

    with LOG_PATH.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as log_file:
        log_file.write(f"\n=== Clipboard history saved at {timestamp} ===\n")
        if unique_strings:
            for index, text in enumerate(unique_strings, start=1):
                log_file.write(f"\n--- Entry {index} ---\n{text}\n")
        else:
            log_file.write("No unique clipboard strings collected.\n")

    print(f"\nSaved {len(unique_strings)} unique strings to {LOG_PATH}")


def main() -> None:
    start_time = time.monotonic()
    saved_history = False
    last_text = None
    unique_strings: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()

    print(f"Watching clipboard every {INTERVAL_SECONDS}s. Press Ctrl+C to stop.")
    print(f"Will save collected unique strings to {LOG_PATH} after 5 minutes.")

    while True:
        try:
            current_text = pyperclip.paste()
        except pyperclip.PyperclipException as exc:
            print(f"Clipboard unavailable: {exc}")
            time.sleep(INTERVAL_SECONDS)
            continue

        if current_text != last_text:
            print("\n--- clipboard changed ---")
            print(current_text)
            last_text = current_text

            if current_text and current_text not in seen:
                seen.add(current_text)
                unique_strings.append(current_text)
                print(f"Added unique string #{len(unique_strings)}")

        if not saved_history and time.monotonic() - start_time >= SAVE_AFTER_SECONDS:
            save_history(unique_strings)
            saved_history = True

        time.sleep(INTERVAL_SECONDS)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nStopped.")
